record.backend: SDL software surface; copied state; no audio/window
SDL software surface; copied state; no audio/window

baseline.main_repair: Identical accepted 89b24f source on both T3 sides; separate exception to original session baseline.

material_check.method: Pinned unchanged material source; same-build named executable, explicit source/object compile records, linked objects/libraries, matching fixture painter objects, ordered build timestamps, and stable input hashes.

limitations: Finite software raster evidence does not establish whole-interface 1:1, real display/DPI, accessibility, audio fidelity or release qualification.
Only typography and clips expose complete model/state; 66 percussion pairs expose limited metadata.
Maximum-size fixtures are 64x64 rack crops with no visible title; they prove exact crop preservation, not maximum-window title rendering or containment.
Canonical Y' density and warm-ink geometry are separate predicates; complete-tool acceptance also requires the unchanged native material suite's 24 complete and 16 clipped header cases.
Clipped pairs use each actual SDL copy result; no uncut resampling is used as a clipped-pixel oracle.

native_material_acceptance.execution: Default mode; exit zero and empty stderr required; original native tolerances unchanged.
